.evWrap {position:relative; width:100%; overflow:hidden; z-index:0; font-family:Pretendard, 'Noto Sans Regular', sans-serif;}
._evt_hide {position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:0; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;}
._look ._pick_tit {left:0; width:100%; font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:9.6vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.192vw; line-height:12.8vw; text-align:center; color:#214C67;}
._look ._soft {font-family:'Cormorant', serif; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0; line-height:normal; white-space:nowrap; color:#3E4F5B; opacity:0.5; writing-mode:vertical-rl;}

._look ._tag ._pill {display:flex; align-items:center; height:6.4vw; padding:1.6vw 2.66667vw; border-radius:8vw; font-size:2.66667vw; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.08vw; line-height:3.2vw; white-space:nowrap; color:#fff;}
._look ._tag ._name {width:100%; margin-top:2.26667vw; font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-0.1vw; line-height:4.66667vw; text-align:center; color:#fff;}
._best ._best_tit {font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:9.6vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.288vw; line-height:12.8vw; text-align:center; color:#214C67;}

._best ._cate_tit {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:1.33333vw; height:6.4vw; font-size:5.33333vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.16vw; line-height:6.4vw; color:#161616;}
._best ._prd_list ._item ._thumb {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:41.33333vw; height:41.33333vw; background-color:#E5E5E5; overflow:hidden;}

._best ._prd_list ._item ._desc {display:-webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; -webkit-line-clamp:2; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-0.1vw; line-height:1.2;}

._exclusive ._gift_list ._only {position:absolute; left:2vw; top:2vw; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:10.66667vw; height:10.66667vw; border-radius:120vw; background-color:#DD153E; font-family:Avenir, Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size:2.4vw; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-0.024vw; line-height:2.66667vw; text-align:center; color:#fff; z-index:1;}

._exclusive ._exc_notice {height:22.66667vw; padding-top:9.33333vw; font-family:'Inter', Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; line-height:4vw; text-align:center; color:#A6B0B6;}

._exclusive ._more {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; min-height:14.66667vw; padding:0 5.33333vw; background-color:#05446D; font-size:4vw; font-weight:500; line-height:1.2; text-align:center; color:#fff;}
